title: McKinnon's left-heel puncture experience in 2006

tellings.quote: I was suddenly woken up by a really sharp pain that immediately I just went in my left heel. There were two perfectly circular holes.
pulled the sock off and in my left heel there were two perfectly circular holes, both about five millimeters in diameter
tellings.difference: Dates it to 2005 rather than 2006, gives the holes as 5 mm across, places it in a first-floor bedsit, and adds later bumps suspected to be an implant.
tellings.link_reason: This is the same night-time heel puncture with two circular holes that McKinnon describes in telling 7.

as_told.title: Two circular holes in heel overnight, later bumps (suspected implant)

plain: One night around 2006 a man named Gary McKinnon, known as a hacker who broke into NASA computers, woke to a sharp pain and found two perfectly round holes in his left heel. McKinnon tells it himself: "There were two perfectly circular holes, both about five millimeters in diameter." In another telling he dates it to 2005, places it in a small first-floor rented room, and adds that bumps appeared later that he suspected were an implant. He tells it as a sign that something was done to him in his sleep.
